gereza.title: Gereza
gereza.description: An AI-powered multiplayer prison escape game where Gemini AI acts as game master, with real-time state sync via Colyseus and a lobby system for managing players.

grtn_2026.title: Ghana Road Transport Network
grtn_2026.description: A JavaFX application for analyzing Ghana's road network, with shortest-path algorithms, cost analysis and interactive graph visualization.

sika.title: Sika
sika.description: A peer-to-peer lending platform for Ashesi students where borrowers request loans, lenders fund them, and repayments are scheduled and tracked.

AUPS_Rocket_Shuttle.title: AUPS Rocket Shuttle
AUPS_Rocket_Shuttle.description: Flight control software for the African Union Panther Shuttle, using sensor fusion and Kalman filtering for stabilization, parachute deployment and autonomous flight.

TradingAlgo.title: Fuzzy Logic Trading Algorithm
TradingAlgo.description: A fuzzy-logic trading signal for the S&P 500 that combines market trend and RSI into buy, hold or sell decisions, charted in the browser.

agent_TikTakToe.title: Unbeatable Tic-Tac-Toe AI
agent_TikTakToe.description: A Q-learning Tic-Tac-Toe AI that learns optimal strategies through gameplay, with a Tkinter interface and a persistent Q-table stored in CSV.

Twitter_Sentimental_Map.title: Twitter Sentiment Map
Twitter_Sentimental_Map.description: Analyzes the sentiment of tweets across the US and draws a map of regional differences in public opinion.

presentationTimer.title: Presentation Timer
presentationTimer.description: A shared countdown timer for capstone presentations: create a timer, share its link, and every viewer sees it start and stop in real time.

uboraui.title: Ubora Tickets
uboraui.description: A JavaFX desktop app for buying event tickets: register, choose a Regular or VIP ticket, and get a ticket with a generated QR code.

inn-mployee.title: InnBucks Employee Onboarding
inn-mployee.description: The HR onboarding web app I built during my InnBucks internship, which cut onboarding time from 3 weeks to under 4 hours.

rationalAgent.title: Rational Vacuum Agent
rationalAgent.description: A Tkinter simulation of a rational vacuum-cleaner agent that navigates a grid and cleans dirt using different strategies.

Hog.title: Hog Dice Game
Hog.description: A digital version of Hog, the UC Berkeley dice game, with pluggable AI strategies and a GUI to play against the computer or a friend.

Ants_And_Bees.title: Ants Vs. SomeBees
Ants_And_Bees.description: A tower-defense game where ants defend their colony against invading bees using unique powers, inspired by Plants Vs. Zombies.

Inventory_System.title: Inventory Management System
Inventory_System.description: An inventory management app with a Tkinter GUI and CSV persistence for adding, updating, deleting and viewing items.

dsa_practise.title: Data Structures in Practice
dsa_practise.description: Data structures built from scratch in Java and applied to everyday problems: a browser history, a music playlist and a contact list.

introtoai.title: Intro to AI Search Algorithms
introtoai.description: Implementations of classic AI search algorithms, starting with best-first search in a vacuum-cleaner world.

truck_plan.title: Truck Plan
truck_plan.description: A scheduling task for planning truck operations.

odin-recipes.title: Odin Recipes
odin-recipes.description: A multi-page recipe site from The Odin Project, featuring Zimbabwean dishes like sadza neMuriwo, nhopi and umxhanxa.

extras.title: Beeply
extras.description: A mentor-mentee matching platform that uses GPT-4o to score and rank mentor compatibility, returning only strong matches above a 70% threshold.
